Pharmacokinetics Absorption of albendazole from the gastrointestinal tract is poor but may be enhanced by a fatty meal. Albendazole rapidly undergoes extensive first-pass metabolism. Its principal metabolite albendazole sulfox- ide has anthelmintic activity and a plasma half-life of about 8.5 hours. Albendazole sulfoxide is widely dis- tributed throughout the body including into the bile and the CSF. It is about 70% bound to plasma protein. Al- bendazole sulfoxide is eliminated in the bile; only a small amount appears to be excreted in the urine. ◊ References. 1. Marriner SE, et al. Pharmacokinetics of albendazole in man.
